question: How can I display a large warning icon with custom color using the Icon component?
ground_truth: You can display a large warning icon with custom color using the Icon component by combining the size and color properties. For example: `<Icon icon="warning" size="7" color="#FF0000" />` where size="7" makes it large and color="#FF0000" would make it red. The size parameter works in 0.25rem increments, so 7 would be 1.75rem.
